fields.name: placed
fields.description: Ordered list of the colors of the cubes that have been put into the bin so far, one entry per completed 'put it into the bin' subgoal, oldest first. The value is always written as a JSON array of double-quoted color strings; at step #1 it is the literal [] (an explicit empty array, never a blank). At the decision step that directly follows an execution of B (the execution steps show a cube held in the gripper and then released over the bin, and the scene at the decision step shows the gripper open with nothing held), append the color of the cube that was held during that execution. Never append after a pick-up execution (one that ends with a cube held) and never after pressing the button. That held-then-released event is always one completed bin placement: count it regardless of where the gripper was reported when the fingers opened (often 30-50 px from the bin's reported center) and regardless of any same-color cube detection appearing on the table at or near the release point in the same frames, since the bin is opaque and detections near it are unreliable. Example sequence over an episode: [] -> [] -> ["green"] -> ["green"] -> ["green", "green"]. e.g. ["green", "green"]
